notes: v218 — DSP-HISTORY-FUTURE (owner's screenshot + words, Oct 21, 2026 19:02 MDT: tomorrow's dispatch stood as the FIRST entry inside History while today's completed dispatch stood in the Today's dispatch card — 'I don't understand the logic? Why is tomorrows dispatch in history and today's completed one is not?'). The v197 classification defined History as 'every dispatch except today's', mixing future-dated saved dispatches in with past ones. The fix (modules/dispatch.js only): (1) History now contains ONLY dispatches dated BEFORE today (local date, the module's own dspRecordDate truth; a dateless record is today's, as always) — the existing date-descending order and the HIST-3 cap with its full-history door are unchanged, and future records no longer consume a History slot (the door count is past records only). Filing is by DATE alone: a past-dated saved (never started) dispatch stays in History; a today-dated record of any status stays out of both lists. (2) Future-dated dispatches render in their own section, 'Upcoming', placed directly under the Today's dispatch card and above Add from a message, sorted nearest-date first. NAMED CHOICE (owner's to overrule): Upcoming rows are the same dspRowHtml rows History used, with their existing Start / Edit / Delete buttons and behaviour unchanged — only the section and placement changed. This supersedes the future-in-History placement v197 left standing (v172's); v172's pin ruling itself is untouched — a future row still shows its pin plainly with no Navigate offer, now in Upcoming (queue-v172 A1-A3 pass unmodified). (3) Today's dispatch handling is untouched — top card; a completed today stays there, never duplicated into History or Upcoming. New suite tools/dsp-history-future-v218-test.js (29 assertions: the owner's exact fixture world — today completed #21625 top-card-only; yesterday completed in History; tomorrow saved in Upcoming only, buttons + plain pin intact; two future days ascending; past saved in History; HIST-3 cap respected with future dispatches present, the door counting 4 past records not 6; the dateless-is-today edge; no future dispatches → no Upcoming card). Superseded pins updated with the ruling cited in place: dsp-today-top-v197 (placement assertions, its Today-region harness now ending at the Upcoming card, the full-history count, two source pins). Standing pin move 217 -> 218 across index.html and the test files.
